title: Water from the Rock
reflectionQuestion: The people were so thirsty, but God brought cool water right out of a dry rock. I wonder what you could ask God for, when you feel like you have run dry?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Moses & Exodus, Exodus 17). Toward-100. Visual provision-miracle (water gushing from a dry rock) -- pairs with Manna (1886) as the desert-provision pair. WATCH-ITEM: the grumbling kept LIGHT (thirsty + worried, like Manna), and God PROVIDES, not punishes (Moses' later striking-in-anger episode is NOT this story). Moses models bringing the need to God in prayer. Room = God provides / bring your needs to God / good things from surprising places. Soft close ('him'). VOICE_BRADFORD (strong male; Moses).
